statement: Reflexive midpoint convexity and diamond distortion. Constructs a real reflexive Banach space with an asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex norm but no equivalent asymptotically uniformly convex norm, extending Baudier's separation to reflexive spaces. In the same space, depth-k countably branching diamonds require distortion at least $`\sqrt{1+k/12}`$, so midpoint uniform convexity does not force uniformly bounded diamond distortion even under reflexivity.
